feature_name: Flashloan evidence driven execution companion specification

architecture.pattern: Extend existing exact engines with versioned evidence-bound contracts and staged admission
architecture.isolation_boundaries: market sources; protected content-addressed evidence; separately authorized signing; receipt truth; cited knowledge
execution_flow: validate request and freeze approved effective policy
bind canonical state, lender and exact costs
compile exact payload and existing-native proof
research report or separately authorized existing admission
journal one economic attempt and reconcile every asset
generate reports and cited knowledge proposals

requirements.title: Stop bounded-search hangs
requirements.contract: Count every call before await, cache seen amounts including rejects, bound timeout/retries, require finite progress; never rank on Number USD

requirements.title: Preserve search uncertainty
requirements.contract: Add result v5; distinguish best-found negative, completed grid, certified domain and coverage failures; preserve all rejection counts

requirements.title: Resolve one effective economic policy
requirements.contract: Separate economic inputs, operator policy, protocol constants and fixture values; no large-principal/deployment/split mandate; preserve installed $10 floor

requirements.title: Reject fabricated execution evidence
requirements.existingSeam: src/liquidity/runtime.ts; execution adapters; public MCP bridge ownership external
requirements.contract: Introduce typed evidence classes and content-addressed raw results; refuse model labels/self-checklists as native evidence; fixture is research-only

requirements.title: Reconcile principal and cash flow
requirements.contract: Conserve principal; count unused once; separate prefund/opening funds; subtract embedded fees once; unknown P&L halts new sends

requirements.title: Use the supported entry path
requirements.output: Single supported workflow and evidence ledger
requirements.contract: Remove narrative bypasses and installed-skill large-size claims as universal recipes; forbid bd-team script imports; map public tools separately from local CLI

requirements.title: Observe real dislocations
requirements.input: Canonical Swap/Mint/Burn/book updates and source watermarks
requirements.output: Coherent before/after frames and observed event IDs
requirements.contract: Extend existing follower/journal; invalidate forks/gaps; emit static-concentration versus observed-flow labels; no fixed 40-tick/$100k trigger rule

requirements.title: Quote depth and normalize identity exactly
requirements.input: Same-state pool snapshots + typed assets + amount
requirements.output: Native integer quote and coverage frontier
requirements.contract: Reuse verified integer math, invert orientation explicitly, stop/expand tick horizon within budgets; no hardcoded fee or indicative USD substitution

requirements.title: Optimize connected routes and splits
requirements.input: Verified graph + effective policy + lender evidence
requirements.output: Feasible closed RoutePlan with search scope
requirements.contract: Bound cycles by supported hops/branches; optimize raw allocations, conserve unused principal, replay shared pools sequentially; compare matched controls

requirements.title: Bind funding and costs at the same state
requirements.input: Lender registry pins + live capacity/fee + fee/cost evidence
requirements.contract: Preserve deployment pins; read mutable fee/capacity near decision; include L1 data cost and conservative valuation; zero only when evidenced or tagged research

requirements.title: Separate allowances from predictions
requirements.output: Descriptive features or admitted model/report binding
requirements.contract: Keep existing prediction admission; add event ordering and censorship/attribution; no forecast from permission alone; preserve unknown recall

requirements.title: Publish generated operational reporting
requirements.existingSeam: src/nim-memory.ts; execution-outcome.ts; local reporting adapter proposed
requirements.input: Typed round events, outcomes and ledgers
requirements.contract: Generate claims from DTOs, not manually typed metrics; keep chain-local/global IDs and denominators separate; missing fields have reasons

requirements.title: Recover state and submissions safely
requirements.input: Attempt journal + transaction/object identity + source cursor
requirements.output: Recovered known state or explicit halted state
requirements.contract: No blind resubmit; reorg/resync and checkpoint object versions invalidate proofs; preserve locks, full-profit custody and private transport

requirements.title: Bridge runtime events to cited knowledge
requirements.existingSeam: src/nim-memory.ts; explicit nim host adapter proposed
requirements.output: Cited observations and provisional learning proposals
requirements.contract: Legacy confidence=8 records are episodes/claims, not truth; hydrate verified citations; TTL key includes state/policy/adapter; owner approves procedures

requirements.title: Ship explicit capability increments
requirements.contract: Keep Robinhood/Sui public research gates until evidence passes; no address/ABI reuse or blanket enablement; Status Network only via future verified adapter

requirements.title: Enforce prompt v3 and regression gates
requirements.existingSeam: prompt/flashloan-prompt.md in bd-team; installed SKILL.md here
requirements.input: Stable prompt + dynamic packet + adversarial operator phrasing
requirements.contract: Remove forced economic defaults; preserve force-trade boundary; map real API fields; freeze policy; embed identical prompt in this export
